scripts.build: npm run check:public-env -- --mode production && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/write-hosting-files.mjs --mode production
scripts.test:config: tsc tests/service-origin.test.ts src/config/service-origin.ts --outDir /tmp/pct-web-config --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/pct-web-config/tests/service-origin.test.js
scripts.test:geometry: tsc tests/chess-geometry.test.ts src/chess.ts --outDir /tmp/pct-web-geometry --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/pct-web-geometry/tests/chess-geometry.test.js
scripts.test:review: tsc tests/review-state.test.ts src/review.ts src/types.ts --outDir /tmp/pct-web-review --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/pct-web-review/tests/review-state.test.js
scripts.test:insights: tsc tests/insights.test.ts src/insights.ts src/types.ts --outDir /tmp/pct-web-insights --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/pct-web-insights/tests/insights.test.js
scripts.test:guest: tsc tests/guest-trial.test.ts src/guest-trial.ts --outDir /tmp/pct-web-guest --module commonjs --moduleResolution node --target ES2022 --skipLibCheck && node /tmp/pct-web-guest/tests/guest-trial.test.js
scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:geometry && npm run test:review && npm run test:insights && npm run test:guest
